newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Lend Lease to end general insurance.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Lend Lease to end general insurance.

text.p: Property developer and financial services group Lend Lease Corp on Tuesday that its MLC insurance and funds management division would withdraw from the general insurance sector at the end of calendar 1996.

MLC chief executive David Clarke also said the division would be restructured to increase its focus on funds management with the purchase of a 33 percent stake in financial administration group FlexiPlan Australia Ltd, based in Perth.
Clarke also said MLC would transfer its traditional life insurance business to a separate company called MLC Lifetime Company Ltd. He did not specify restructuring costs.
Referring to the general insurance business, Clarke said MLC was only a small player, ranked 23rd in Australia, and he did not believe the company could remain competitive.
"No further general insurance policies will be written after 31 December 1996," he said.
"Arrangements will be in place for another major general insurance company to offer cover when MLC policy renewals fall due. No customer will be disadvantaged."
Clarke said MLC would assist employees to find other jobs within MLC, where possible.
